verses.text: Praise YHWH, all you nations; adore Him, all [you] peoples!

segments.text: Praise YHWH, all you nations; adore Him, all [you] peoples!

verses.text: For mighty [is] His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of YHWH [is] forever. Hallelu YAH!
